description.en: Sets a camera's look-at point from an array [x, y, z] (at most 3 values read; integers are converted).

true once set, false if the camera is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Placing the active camera at the field view (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, SetExitRpgCamera)
